t: Medium utility hooks for hanging coats, dog leads, hand towels and many other household items. They hold strongly and remove cleanly using 3M stretch-release technology. Strips stretch off cleanly without leaving holes, marks or sticky residue. Suitable for most smooth surfaces including painted walls, tiles, metal and wood. Not suitable for unpainted paper or vinyl wallpaper. Not suitable for humid environments.
b: No Need for Nails or Screws
